_help: MCP servers FATMEE connects to at startup. ${NAME} is replaced with that value from backend/.env. A server whose required_env is missing is skipped (FATMEE still starts). 'expose' lists tool names (or parts of names) the planner may call directly; 'approval' lists tools that must wait for the user's OK.

tavily.description: Web search and page reading by Tavily (remote, nothing installed locally).
